entries.rationale: Reviewed after central deployment-contract compatibility fix: the scanner match is the runtime permit-token variable flow (`token = safeStorageGet(...)`), not a static credential literal. Hash-bound exception invalidates on any future source change.

Re-reviewed exact updated report.js after adding Conversation Lab to pilot reporting. Scanner-assigned `apiKey` literal is a from/to cache key, not a stored or transmitted API secret. This exception remains restricted to the exact file Git blob and assigned-secret-literal rule; private-key scans never accept this exception.
Signed permit token is generated at runtime from user input/signature; no static credential literal.

Exact historical negative browser test injects CLB_DUMMY_USER and CLB_DUMMY_PASSWORD at example.invalid to verify credential redaction. The network is intercepted; these explicit dummy strings are not credentials. Exception restricted to this test blob and credential-url rule, never private-key material.
